connector.name: MCP Enrichment
connector.registryDescription: Multi-source entity enrichment: company data, contacts, email verification, and phone validation
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-enrichment. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the intelagentstudios account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
